method: Replay of measured progressive search at a 1000 ms deadline. Evaluation wall times include worker round trips; scheduling noise means a boundary case may complete differently live. Foregone gain compares both chosen boards at the baseline deepest completed depth, not perfect play. Reference differences only use covered cubeless rows. Test rows were held out from timing-model fitting/selection; the stopping heuristic also has prior exploratory evidence from the original 300-position dataset.
